summary: Savers Value Village filed an 8-K announcing its second-quarter fiscal 2026 financial results, including a 7.4% net sales increase to $448.2 million, driven by 6.6% U.S. comparable store sales growth and new store openings. The filing also disclosed the launch of ThriftIQ, a proprietary pricing platform developed with Kaizen Analytix, and updated fiscal 2026 outlook. These are routine operational and financial disclosures, not special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. No deal terms, premiums, board recommendations, or structural changes are present.
